Specification: This specification models Safra's distributed termination detection algorithm on a ring, based on EWD 998. The system consists of nodes with activation state, color, local counters, pending messages, and a circulating token that carries a position, a quantity, and a color; the environment may send messages, receive messages, and deactivate nodes asynchronously. The spec defines safety properties about correct termination detection, an inductive invariant attributed to Safra, a liveness property stating that termination is eventually detected under weak fairness of the system actions, and a bounded state constraint for model checking.
IfThenElse: IF token.pos = N-1 THEN token.q = 0 ELSE token.q = FoldFunctionOnSet(Plus, 0, counter, {x \in Node: (token.pos+1) <= x})
IF firstIndex > loopIndex THEN loopIndex ELSE firstIndex
FunctionOverride:
[token EXCEPT !.pos = @ - 1,
                            !.q = @ + counter[i],
                            !.color = IF color[i] = "black" THEN "black" ELSE @]
